alice.tuplecentre
Class Event

java.lang.Object
  alice.tuplecentre.Event
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
InputEvent, OutputEvent, ReactionEvent
public abstract class Event
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable

Represents events of the tuple centre virtual machine According to the tuple centre model, an event is characterised by the operation that caused the event, the direction of the event (from agent to the tuple centre, or viceversa), the identification of the agent related to the operation.

See Also:
TupleCentreVM, Serialized Form
